---
title: "Practical 2 · Describing data"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
patients <- read.csv("../../data/patients.csv")
```

## Exercise 1 · Summaries

::: {.callout-note .exercise}
## Exercise 1
Give the median and interquartile range of `bmi`, overall and by `sex`.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.solution}
```{r}
quantile(patients$bmi, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
tapply(patients$bmi, patients$sex, median)
```
:::
:::

## Exercise 2 · A figure

::: {.callout-note .exercise}
## Exercise 2
Draw a histogram of `age`, filled in Neudata teal (`"#055F56"`).
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.solution}
```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.5
ggplot(patients, aes(age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#055F56", colour = "white") +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Patients") +
  theme_minimal()
```
:::
:::
